questions.prompt: The plot is less original ___ the previous one.
The play is not as long ___ the film.
I prefer a comedy ___ a thriller today.

Nora and Dan are choosing a film. Nora prefers a comedy because she wants to laugh. Dan enjoys science-fiction films, but today he agrees to watch the comedy. After the film, they write a review. They think the acting is really good, although the plot is less original than the plot of the previous film.

Why does Nora prefer a comedy?
